decisions.reason: A rye country bread is a core staple for a German bakery and fits its established range. With no sign of a shortfall against aspirations, there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The premium raisin stollen won the Deutsches Brotinstitut gold medal again, so it clearly exceeds aspirations and reinforces the firm's reputation.
This seeded rye mixed bread suits current health trends and uses existing rye processes. No negative evidence was reported, so keeping it costs little.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche but typical German speciality. With no reported results either way, the firm's slack lets it carry the product while its performance remains uncertain.
The marzipan stollen is a seasonal complement to the award-winning stollen line. It shares the same production and sales channels, so it can be kept within the current routine.
The ancient grain bread was just introduced as the firm's newest 'Meisterstück' and targets a growing premium segment. It is too early for a shortfall to show, so management will give it time.
